北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感-5℃，出门多穿保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear and cold, feels like -5℃. Dress warmly when going out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，能见度低，注意交通安全，别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, low visibility. Drive safe and don't catch a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好但体感 1℃，记得多加衣，暖暖和和。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear but feels like 1℃. Remember to add clothes to stay warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，风吹微凉。早晚温差大，别忘添衣。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, a bit cool with wind. Mind the temp difference, add layers.
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感舒适。昼夜温差在，注意添减衣物。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels comfortable. Watch for day-night temp changes.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，气温 3℃，出行注意安全，做好防寒。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, 3℃. Travel safely and keep warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴冷，体感-1℃，湿度高。出门注意防寒防湿！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear and cold, feels like -1℃ with high humidity. Keep warm and dry!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 8℃。早晚温差大，记得加件外套。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 8℃. Mind the day-night temp difference, bring a jacket.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉雾气浓，体感 0℃。小心慢行，防湿保暖哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy, feels like 0℃. Drive slowly, keep warm and dry.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 0℃。湿冷感强，多穿些别着凉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 0℃. It's damp and cold, dress warmly.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，风力 3级，体感 6℃。多带件衣服防风！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 6℃ with wind. Bring an extra layer for wind.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨-16℃，体感-20℃！出门全副武装，注意防冻。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -16℃, feels like -20℃! Bundle up completely to prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳-15℃，体感-19℃！户外严寒，务必厚实保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is -15℃, feels like -19℃! It's freezing outside, dress very warmly.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，13℃。阳光正好，出门散步享受好天气！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and 13℃. Perfect for a walk, enjoy the lovely weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，11℃。湿度较高，出门带伞，注意保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 11℃ with high humidity. Bring an umbrella, keep warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感-3℃。戴好口罩，注意防寒，保护健康。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze, feels like -3℃. Wear a mask, keep warm, stay healthy.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感-8℃，注意保暖。多喝热水，别感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -8℃. Stay warm, drink hot water, avoid colds.
